title: Revived Modpack
description: The Modpack from the German Story-Project Minecraft Revived on Youtube
body:
This is the Modpack of the German Youtube-Storyproject Minecraft Revived (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Ak8j_pFncs&list=PLWEX5LPAXMbcHYNMf998GnetK7uu8eF5b). 
In general, there are Multiple Mods, wichshould provide a base for evry Story Project. 
Cause the purpose of this modpack is to use it as an Story/Roleplay modpack, there are all kinds of Mods:
Multiple Worldgen mods for a better and Smoother World, 
Multiple Bossmob-mods for variety in Mobs to fight in a Story, 
CustomNPCs for Storytelling in the Game, 
Distant Horizons for Nicer View distances, 
Macew`s mods for Decoration, 
Multiple Airplane mods for cool Air Spectacles, 
Multiple Weapon mods reaching from Medival Weapons to Futuristic Laser cannons, 
Maaaaaany performance mods to provide smooth Storymaking even on Older systems or Laptops, 
Miniature Shader for the best mix of Cool shading and Performance, 
And Many other mods for making Storys like Replay mod, Worldedit and co.

The modpack will be Updated and ever be on the Newest version. Even the Skins of the NPCs are Included!
